_readme: MIXOMESH material presets — the list the Print ▸ Export ▸ Cost 'Material' menu offers.
Edit this file to add, remove or re-price presets, then restart the app (web: reload; desktop: this is
the copy in your user data folder — the path is shown under the Material menu).
Values typed into the Cost panel change the CURRENT setting only; they are never written back here.
Fields: id (unique, stable), name, process (FDM | Resin | SLS | Full-colour | Custom), densityGcm3,
pricePerGram, supportPricePerGram, supportDensityGcm3, defaultSupportPercent (support volume as % of
model volume), setupFee (flat charge per export job, same currency), note.
PRICING BASIS (2026-09-19): these are CONSERVATIVE PRINT-SERVICE RATES — what a print bureau charges a
customer, upper-middle of the 2026 range — not what a spool or a litre costs. Use them when you print for
others and must not lose money. The raw material cost is in each note. 2026 service survey: FDM
0.10–0.30 USD/g + 3–10 USD setup; nylon / carbon-fibre +50–100 %; resin SLA 0.20–0.50 USD/g + setup;
SLS PA12 ~0.40 USD/g (PA+GF 0.60); full-colour bureaus 1–10 USD per cm³. Full-colour inkjet (Mimaki
3DUJ) ink is dealer-quoted — that preset is a placeholder to replace with your own numbers.

materials.name: PLA
materials.note: Service rate; raw filament ~0.02 USD/g. General purpose.

materials.name: PLA+ / Tough PLA
materials.note: Service rate; raw ~0.027 USD/g. Impact-modified PLA.

materials.name: PETG
materials.note: Service rate; raw ~0.025 USD/g. Tougher than PLA, some temperature resistance.

materials.name: ABS
materials.note: Service rate; raw ~0.028 USD/g. Enclosure needed; sandable, acetone-smoothable.

materials.name: ASA
materials.note: Service rate; raw ~0.030 USD/g. UV-stable ABS alternative for outdoor parts.

materials.name: TPU 95A (flexible)
materials.note: Service rate; raw ~0.030 USD/g. Flexible; supports hard to remove.

materials.name: Nylon (PA6 / PA12)
materials.note: Service rate; raw ~0.045 USD/g. Strong, wear-resistant; dry before printing.

materials.name: PLA-CF / PETG-CF
materials.note: Service rate; raw ~0.040 USD/g. Carbon-fibre filled; hardened nozzle.

materials.name: Standard resin (405 nm)
materials.note: Service rate; raw ~0.027 USD/g (25–30 USD/L). Hobby LCD/MSLA resin.

materials.name: Tough / ABS-like resin
materials.note: Service rate; raw ~0.045 USD/g. Impact-resistant engineering resin.

materials.name: Water-washable resin
materials.note: Service rate; raw ~0.030 USD/g. No IPA wash; slightly more brittle.

materials.name: 8K / miniature resin
materials.note: Service rate; raw ~0.040 USD/g. Low-shrink, fine detail; heavy supports on figures.

materials.name: PA12 nylon (SLS powder)
materials.note: Service rate; raw powder ~0.09 USD/g. Powder bed, no supports; density = sintered part.

materials.name: Mimaki 3DUJ model ink (MH-100)
materials.note: PLACEHOLDER — dealer-quoted ink; bureaus bill full colour at 1–10 USD per cm³ (~1–9 USD/g). Replace with your quote. Water-soluble support.

materials.name: Custom (type your own)
materials.note: Density 1.0; fill in price / support / setup in the panel.
